clips.title: The story
paras: Elder Morningdew is an ancient night elf spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival in Thousand Needles. She offers wisdom and ancestral blessings to travelers who seek her out amid the arid canyons and dried salt flats of the Shimmering Flats.

Throughout the Lunar Festival, the spirits of revered ancestors manifest across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms to celebrate wisdom, legacy, and peace. Elder Morningdew is one such apparition, visiting Thousand Needles to greet honoring pilgrims. Bound by neither faction nor mortal conflict, she bestows her coin of ancestry upon any adventurer respectful enough to seek her counsel and receive her blessing.
